status: qualified bounded startup measurements; research-only cause analysis
method:
Publish GLM startup samples and rank-level diagnostics without request text.

Throughput comes from unprofiled windows. Trace summaries retain all ranks and
iterations, including profiler-start skew. Kernel inventory signatures include
names, launch geometry and invocation counts, but exclude durations. Matching
signatures rule out an observed launch-inventory change, not every runtime cause.

mtp.status: qualified bounded serving measurements; diagnostic traces
mtp.method:
Export matched TP4 serving rates and bounded, per-rank CUDA traces.

Unprofiled decode windows are the throughput evidence. Trace kernel durations
overlap across streams and profiler startup can skew ranks; neither kernel
sums nor profiled wall time replace the unprofiled measurements. Every rank
and captured iteration is retained. No model prompts or responses are exported.
mtp.rank_arrival_method:
Locate rank-arrival skew in bounded TP4 PCIe all-reduce traces.

The analysis pairs equal ordered collective geometries across four ranks and
requires a shared profiler clock origin. Arrival skew includes work before
the collective; the completion tail starts when the last rank arrives. Neither
is a standalone communication benchmark. Every captured step is retained,
including profiler-start skew. Per-stream graph gaps use one launch correlation
and retain their complete range rather than dropping long gaps.

cell_telemetry.method:
Join decode-cell events to device telemetry without starting GPU work.

Cell boundaries include request startup and draining, not just the benchmark's
scored interval. Event timestamps resolve to seconds and device samples to
roughly two seconds. These observations describe clocks and temperature; they
do not prove a cause for a throughput difference.

cuda_connections.status: qualified bounded serving measurements; research-only queue-capacity diagnosis
cuda_connections.method:
Compare cached GLM serving with default and 128 CUDA connection capacity.

CUDA hardware connection capacity is the only permitted launch difference.
Both launches request sixteen NCCL channels. API and four-rank /proc snapshots
must retain the connection setting. /proc is not live getenv: process-title
rewrites can erase entries, so missing worker settings are recorded as unknown,
not silently treated as unset. Five unprofiled C1 windows measure throughput;
separate four-rank traces are diagnostics, not throughput samples.
